lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gills. The central row contains approximately seven primary spots spaced evenly, while the dorsal and ventral rows show more irregular, smaller clusters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a semi-regular grid-like matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow transition along their ventral edges, extending from the post-cranial region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 8-12 low-contrast, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily in the lower two-thirds of the fin's surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of small, high-luminance spots is visible on the distal tip and posterior margin of the left pectoral fin.
